text.tspan: The US Postal Inspection Service on Kenner's cameras: 52,572 searches, one redacted identity
​Reasons given are dominated by mail theft, opaque case numbers, and generic 'investigation'; narcotics is the #2 substantive category.​
​Explicitly immigration-related reasons: 5 of 52,572 ('ERO MKE suspect', 'USPIS/HSI Investigation').​
​But ~21% bare case numbers and ~18% generic reasons mean the reason field cannot rule out other uses. Full months only: Jan 2024 - Dec 2025.​

text.tspan: Source: public record request (Flock audit logs, full months only Jan 2024 - Dec 2025, USPIS rows only): https://www.muckrock.com/foi/kenner-16256/public-records-request-flock-audits-201972/
Categories are keyword groupings of the free-text 'reason' field; full rules and every unclassified reason: this folder's script.
More info on the methodology on github.com/eye-on-surveillance
